accepted.quote: As such, the loan level increases to the 7(a) program currently in H.R. 3174 remain far too imprudent to earn my support.

accepted.quote: As I've stated, I am open to a discussion on increasing loan caps for manufacturers in the 504/CDC program and Committee staff has expressed that position to the majority staff on multiple occasions.
